name: MediTrack mobile design system
status: Design specification; Figma-native implementation and assistive-technology validation require separate evidence.

styles.name: H1
styles.use: Welcome or an occasional single page title; use only one H1 per screen.

styles.name: H2
styles.use: Primary screen heading: Today, Medicines, Appointment summary.

styles.name: H3
styles.use: Major tablet pane or dialog heading.

styles.name: H4
styles.use: Medication names and primary card headings.

styles.name: H6
styles.use: Small section headings; preserve logical heading order.

styles.name: Body
styles.use: Default medication details, instructions, helper copy, and paragraphs.

styles.name: Body emphasized
styles.use: Dosage, status words, and short important phrases.

styles.name: Body small
styles.use: Secondary timestamps and supporting metadata; never critical dosage text.

styles.name: Label
styles.use: Buttons, inputs, navigation, and badges; wrap to additional lines.

typography.scaling: Support OS Dynamic Type / font scaling to at least 200%. Use min-height, content-driven height, wrapping, and stacked actions.

units.Android: dp, with 48 px on a 1x design canvas

targets.note: All design controls use at least 48x48 logical units, exceeding 44x44pt iOS minimum. Do not interpret raw physical device pixels as dp.

breakpoints.compact: <600 logical units: one column, four-item bottom navigation
breakpoints.medium: 600–839: navigation rail plus one column or two adaptive cards
breakpoints.expanded: >=840: navigation rail plus list/detail panes when space allows

layout.safeArea: Respect system status bar, camera cutout, gesture/home indicator, keyboard, and Android edge-to-edge insets.

motion.reduceMotion: Remove nonessential animation, replace spinning loaders with static icon plus Loading text, retain progress values.

colorPolicy.focus: Focus ring is separated from control fill by a 3-unit surface-colored gap; ring only touches the surface/background. Never put focus color directly against a brand fill.
colorPolicy.disabled: Disabled components retain readable text and a visible boundary. Also announce disabled; never opacity-fade the entire component.
colorPolicy.status: Due, Taken, Skipped, and Missed always include a word and an icon. Color is supplementary.
